BENILLA_HERB_ART = "Interface\\Benilla\\herbalism\\" BENILLA_HERB_SIZE = 5 BENILLA_HERB_MARGIN = 18 BENILLA_HERB_WIDTH = 600 BENILLA_HERB_TILE = 68 BENILLA_HERB_GAP = 4 BENILLA_HERB_HEDGE = 12 BENILLA_HERB_BED_TOP = 188 BENILLA_HERB_PIP_ROW = 6 BENILLA_HERB_BASKET_ROWS = 6 BENILLA_HERB_LOG_ENTRIES = 12 BENILLA_HERB_MISSED_ALPHA = 0.45 BENILLA_HERB_GLOW_PERIOD = 1.6 -- The tool item's name to its skill, and the consumable item's name to what it asks of the -- player. A name missing here shows no button. BENILLA_HERB_SKILLS = { ["Herbalist's Sickle"] = "Sweep", ["Herbalist's Trowel"] = "Probe", ["Herbalist's Shears"] = "Snip", } BENILLA_HERB_CONSUMABLES = { ["Elixir of Herb Sight"] = "sight", ["Weedcutter's Twine"] = "twine", ["Forager's Charm"] = "charm", } BENILLA_HERB_CLOSED = { [0] = "Out of pulls.", [1] = "You cleared the patch.", [2] = "You leave the patch.", [3] = "You are hurt, and drop the patch.", [4] = "You walk away from the patch.", } -- The end card's first line, by the `over` reason. BENILLA_HERB_OVER = { [0] = "Out of pulls.", [1] = "Every tile pulled.", } -- A log entry's left border by kind: plant, weed, thorn, tool skill, consumable. BENILLA_HERB_LOG_COLOURS = { [0] = { 0.659, 0.522, 0.235 }, [1] = { 0.420, 0.353, 0.173 }, [2] = { 0.541, 0.200, 0.145 }, [3] = { 1.000, 0.820, 0.000 }, [4] = { 0.541, 0.361, 1.000 }, } BENILLA_HERB_XP_COLOUR = { 0.541, 0.361, 1.000 } BENILLA_HERB_AXIS_COLOUR = { 0.788, 0.690, 0.541 } BENILLA_HERB_SIGHT_PICKS = 3
BenillaHerbState = { mode = nil, across = true, sight = {}, log = {}, missing = false, start = 0, clock = 0 }
function BenillaHerb_ItemInfo(item) if not item or item == 0 then return nil end local name, _, quality, _, _, _, _, _, texture = GetItemInfo(item) if not name then BenillaHerbState.missing = true end return name, quality, texture end
-- An item quality's colour as r, g, b; white when the client has no table for it. function BenillaHerb_Colour(quality) local colour = ITEM_QUALITY_COLORS and ITEM_QUALITY_COLORS[quality or 1] if colour then return colour.r, colour.g, colour.b end return 1, 1, 1 end
-- An item's name wrapped in its rarity colour code; "Unknown plant" until the client knows it. function BenillaHerb_Coloured(item) local name, quality = BenillaHerb_ItemInfo(item) local r, g, b = BenillaHerb_Colour(quality) return string.format("|cff%02x%02x%02x%s|r", math.floor(r * 255), math.floor(g * 255), math.floor(b * 255), name or "Unknown plant") end
function BenillaHerb_Plural(n, word) if n == 1 then return n .. " " .. word end return n .. " " .. word .. "s" end
-- Four 1 px lines along the frame's edges, `out` units outside them. function BenillaHerb_Lines(frame, out, r, g, b, a) local top = frame:CreateTexture(nil, "BORDER") top:SetTexture(r, g, b, a) top:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", frame, "TOPLEFT", -out, out) top:SetPoint("TOPRIGHT", frame, "TOPRIGHT", out, out) top:SetHeight(1) local bottom = frame:CreateTexture(nil, "BORDER") bottom:SetTexture(r, g, b, a) bottom:SetPoint("BOTTOMLEFT", frame, "BOTTOMLEFT", -out, -out) bottom:SetPoint("BOTTOMRIGHT", frame, "BOTTOMRIGHT", out, -out) bottom:SetHeight(1) local left = frame:CreateTexture(nil, "BORDER") left:SetTexture(r, g, b, a) left:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", frame, "TOPLEFT", -out, out) left:SetPoint("BOTTOMLEFT", frame, "BOTTOMLEFT", -out, -out) left:SetWidth(1) local right = frame:CreateTexture(nil, "BORDER") right:SetTexture(r, g, b, a) right:SetPoint("TOPRIGHT", frame, "TOPRIGHT", out, out) right:SetPoint("BOTTOMRIGHT", frame, "BOTTOMRIGHT", out, -out) right:SetWidth(1) end
-- The panel recipe: a brown gradient, a gold line on each edge and a black line outside it. function BenillaHerb_Panel(frame) local bg = frame:CreateTexture(nil, "BACKGROUND") bg:SetTexture(1, 1, 1, 1) bg:SetAllPoints(frame) bg:SetGradient("VERTICAL", 0.153, 0.106, 0.063, 0.220, 0.157, 0.094) BenillaHerb_Lines(frame, 0, 0.659, 0.522, 0.235, 1) BenillaHerb_Lines(frame, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1) end
-- The chip recipe of chips, basket rows, log entries and the end card: a dark fill and a -- 1 px gold-dim border. function BenillaHerb_ChipBack(frame) local bg = frame:CreateTexture(nil, "BACKGROUND") bg:SetTexture(0, 0, 0, 0.28) bg:SetAllPoints(frame) BenillaHerb_Lines(frame, 0, 0.431, 0.337, 0.161, 1) end
function BenillaHerb_Chip(name) local chip = CreateFrame("Frame", name, BenillaHerbPatch) chip:SetHeight(18) BenillaHerb_ChipBack(chip) local text = BenillaHerb_Text(chip, name .. "Text", "GameFontHighlightSmall") text:SetPoint("LEFT", chip, "LEFT", 6, 0) chip:Hide() return chip end
-- A FontString of `font`, or of no font when the client has no such object. function BenillaHerb_Text(parent, name, font) return parent:CreateFontString(name, "ARTWORK", getglobal(font) and font or nil) end
function BenillaHerb_Texture(parent, name, layer, art, w, h) local tex = parent:CreateTexture(name, layer) tex:SetTexture(BENILLA_HERB_ART .. art) tex:SetWidth(w) tex:SetHeight(h) return tex end
-- Everything the window repeats: tiles, axis labels, the bed's hedge, chips, basket rows, the -- legend's samples and the pull log's entries. function BenillaHerb_Build() local margin = BENILLA_HERB_MARGIN BenillaHerb_Panel(BenillaHerbPatch) BenillaHerb_Panel(BenillaHerbLogPanel)
-- The bed: four hedge corners, four edges and the soil, with the tiles on the soil. local bed, hedge = BenillaHerbBed, BENILLA_HERB_HEDGE local soil = bed:CreateTexture("BenillaHerbBedSoil", "BACKGROUND") soil:SetTexture(BENILLA_HERB_ART .. "bed_soil") soil:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", bed, "TOPLEFT", hedge, -hedge) soil:SetPoint("BOTTOMRIGHT", bed, "BOTTOMRIGHT", -hedge, hedge) for _, c in ipairs({ { "tl", "TOPLEFT" }, { "tr", "TOPRIGHT" }, { "bl", "BOTTOMLEFT" }, { "br", "BOTTOMRIGHT" } }) do local corner = BenillaHerb_Texture(bed, nil, "BORDER", "bed_corner_" .. c[1], hedge, hedge) corner:SetPoint(c[2], bed, c[2], 0, 0) end local top = BenillaHerb_Texture(bed, nil, "BORDER", "bed_edge_top", hedge, hedge) top:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", bed, "TOPLEFT", hedge, 0) top:SetPoint("TOPRIGHT", bed, "TOPRIGHT", -hedge, 0) local bottom = BenillaHerb_Texture(bed, nil, "BORDER", "bed_edge_bottom", hedge, hedge) bottom:SetPoint("BOTTOMLEFT", bed, "BOTTOMLEFT", hedge, 0) bottom:SetPoint("BOTTOMRIGHT", bed, "BOTTOMRIGHT", -hedge, 0) local left = BenillaHerb_Texture(bed, nil, "BORDER", "bed_edge_left", hedge, hedge) left:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", bed, "TOPLEFT", 0, -hedge) left:SetPoint("BOTTOMLEFT", bed, "BOTTOMLEFT", 0, hedge) local right = BenillaHerb_Texture(bed, nil, "BORDER", "bed_edge_right", hedge, hedge) right:SetPoint("TOPRIGHT", bed, "TOPRIGHT", 0, -hedge) right:SetPoint("BOTTOMRIGHT", bed, "BOTTOMRIGHT", 0, hedge)
local size, step = BENILLA_HERB_SIZE, BENILLA_HERB_TILE + BENILLA_HERB_GAP local axis = BENILLA_HERB_AXIS_COLOUR for i = 1, size * size do local tile = CreateFrame("Button", "BenillaHerbTile" .. i, bed, "BenillaHerbTileTemplate") tile:SetID(i) local row, col = math.floor((i - 1) / size), math.mod(i - 1, size) tile:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", bed, "TOPLEFT", hedge + col * step, -(hedge + row * step)) end for n = 1, size do local letter = BenillaHerb_Text(BenillaHerbPatch, "BenillaHerbCol" .. n, "GameFontNormalSmall") letter:SetText(string.sub("ABCDEFGH", n, n)) letter:SetTextColor(axis[1], axis[2], axis[3]) letter:SetPoint("BOTTOM", bed, "TOPLEFT", hedge + (n - 1) * step + BENILLA_HERB_TILE / 2, 2) local number = BenillaHerb_Text(BenillaHerbPatch, "BenillaHerbRow" .. n, "GameFontNormalSmall") number:SetText(tostring(n)) number:SetTextColor(axis[1], axis[2], axis[3]) number:SetPoint("RIGHT", bed, "TOPLEFT", -4, -(hedge + (n - 1) * step + BENILLA_HERB_TILE / 2)) end
-- The Basket's rows, two per line. local half = (BENILLA_HERB_WIDTH - 2 * margin - 8) / 2 for n = 1, BENILLA_HERB_BASKET_ROWS do local name = "BenillaHerbBasket" .. n local row = CreateFrame("Frame", name, BenillaHerbPatch) row:SetWidth(half) row:SetHeight(16) row:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", BenillaHerbBasketTitle, "BOTTOMLEFT", math.mod(n - 1, 2) * (half + 8), -4 - math.floor((n - 1) / 2) * 18) BenillaHerb_ChipBack(row) local glyph = row:CreateTexture(name .. "Glyph", "ARTWORK") glyph:SetWidth(14) glyph:SetHeight(14) glyph:SetPoint("LEFT", row, "LEFT", 3, 0) local label = BenillaHerb_Text(row, name .. "Name", "GameFontHighlightSmall") label:SetPoint("LEFT", row, "LEFT", 21, 0) local count = BenillaHerb_Text(row, name .. "Count", "GameFontNormalSmall") count:SetPoint("RIGHT", row, "RIGHT", -6, 0) row:Hide() end
-- The legend: two samples per line in two columns, then the hover hint. local samples = { { "stake", "Stake: plants still hidden in the touching tiles" }, { "bush_hidden_1", "Glowing bush: you know a plant is here", true }, { "bush_wilted_1", "Wilted bush: known weed" }, { "bush_thorn_1", "Red bush: known thorn" }, } for n, s in ipairs(samples) do local x, y = math.mod(n - 1, 2) * 290, -math.floor((n - 1) / 2) * 14 local w = s[1] == "stake" and 7 or 14 local tex = BenillaHerb_Texture(BenillaHerbLegend, "BenillaHerbLegendSample" .. n, "ARTWORK", s[1], w, 14) tex:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", BenillaHerbLegend, "TOPLEFT", x + (14 - w) / 2, y) if s[3] then local glow = BenillaHerb_Texture(BenillaHerbLegend, nil, "OVERLAY", "bush_glow", 14, 14) glow:SetPoint("CENTER", tex, "CENTER", 0, 0) end local text = BenillaHerb_Text(BenillaHerbLegend, "BenillaHerbLegendText" .. n, "GameFontHighlightSmall") text:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", BenillaHerbLegend, "TOPLEFT", x + 18, y - 1) text:SetText(s[2]) end BenillaHerbLegendHint:SetText("Hover a pulled spot to see the tiles its number counts.") BenillaHerb_ChipBack(BenillaHerbEnd)
-- The pull log's entries, newest at the top. for n = 1, BENILLA_HERB_LOG_ENTRIES do local name = "BenillaHerbLogEntry" .. n local entry = CreateFrame("Frame", name, BenillaHerbLogPanel) entry:SetWidth(260 - 28) entry:SetHeight(36) entry:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", BenillaHerbLogPanel, "TOPLEFT", 14, -40 - (n - 1) * 40) BenillaHerb_ChipBack(entry) local bar = entry:CreateTexture(name .. "Bar", "ARTWORK") bar:SetWidth(3) bar:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", entry, "TOPLEFT", 0, 0) bar:SetPoint("BOTTOMLEFT", entry, "BOTTOMLEFT", 0, 0) local title = BenillaHerb_Text(entry, name .. "Title", "GameFontNormal") title:SetWidth(150) title:SetJustifyH("LEFT") title:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", entry, "TOPLEFT", 9, -5) local place = BenillaHerb_Text(entry, name .. "Place", "GameFontHighlightSmall") place:SetJustifyH("RIGHT") place:SetTextColor(0.6, 0.6, 0.6) place:SetPoint("TOPRIGHT", entry, "TOPRIGHT", -6, -6) local xp = BenillaHerb_Text(entry, name .. "Xp", "GameFontHighlightSmall") xp:SetTextColor(BENILLA_HERB_XP_COLOUR[1], BENILLA_HERB_XP_COLOUR[2], BENILLA_HERB_XP_COLOUR[3]) xp:SetPoint("BOTTOMLEFT", entry, "BOTTOMLEFT", 9, 5) entry:Hide() end BenillaHerbXPBar:SetStatusBarColor(BENILLA_HERB_XP_COLOUR[1], BENILLA_HERB_XP_COLOUR[2], BENILLA_HERB_XP_COLOUR[3]) BenillaHerbState.chips = {} BenillaHerbState.known = {} end
-- The tiles a hovered tile `i` would cover in the armed mode, as a set. function BenillaHerb_Covered(i) local size = BENILLA_HERB_SIZE local row, col = math.floor((i - 1) / size), math.mod(i - 1, size) local set = {} local mode = BenillaHerbState.mode local skill = BenillaHerbState.skill if mode == "twine" or (mode == "skill" and skill == "Probe") then for r = row - 1, row + 1 do for c = col - 1, col + 1 do if r >= 0 and r < size and c >= 0 and c < size then set[r * size + c + 1] = true end end end elseif mode == "skill" and skill == "Sweep" then for n = 0, size - 1 do if BenillaHerbState.across then set[row * size + n + 1] = true else set[n * size + col + 1] = true end end elseif mode then set[i] = true end return set end
-- The eight tiles around tile `i`, which its stake counts. function BenillaHerb_Around(i) local size = BENILLA_HERB_SIZE local row, col = math.floor((i - 1) / size), math.mod(i - 1, size) local set = {} for r = row - 1, row + 1 do for c = col - 1, col + 1 do if r >= 0 and r < size and c >= 0 and c < size and not (r == row and c == col) then set[r * size + c + 1] = true end end end return set end
function BenillaHerbTile_Paint(i) local base = "BenillaHerbTile" .. i local state, known, stake, item, _, _, part, missed = GetHerbTile(i) local tile, bush, glyph = getglobal(base), getglobal(base .. "Bush"), getglobal(base .. "Glyph") local glow, name = getglobal(base .. "Glow"), getglobal(base .. "Name") glyph:Hide() glow:Hide() glyph:SetVertexColor(1, 1, 1) name:SetText("") bush:SetTexCoord(0, 1, 0, 1) if not state or state == 0 then -- The bush's shape and facing follow the 0-based tile number, so it keeps its look. local kind = "hidden" if known == 2 then kind = "wilted" elseif known == 3 then kind = "thorn" end bush:SetTexture(BENILLA_HERB_ART .. "bush_" .. kind .. "_" .. (math.mod(i - 1, 3) + 1)) if math.mod(math.floor((i - 1) / 3), 2) == 1 then bush:SetTexCoord(1, 0, 0, 1) end if known == 1 then glow:Show() end elseif state == 1 then bush:SetTexture(BENILLA_HERB_ART .. "mound") local itemName, quality = BenillaHerb_ItemInfo(item) local r, g, b = BenillaHerb_Colour(quality) if part and part ~= "" then glyph:SetTexture(BENILLA_HERB_ART .. "glyph_" .. part) glyph:SetVertexColor(r, g, b) glyph:Show() end if itemName then name:SetText(itemName) name:SetTextColor(r, g, b) end elseif state == 2 then bush:SetTexture(BENILLA_HERB_ART .. "mound") glyph:SetTexture(BENILLA_HERB_ART .. "part_weed") glyph:Show() else bush:SetTexture(BENILLA_HERB_ART .. "mound_thorn") glyph:SetTexture(BENILLA_HERB_ART .. "part_thorn") glyph:Show() end tile:SetAlpha(missed and BENILLA_HERB_MISSED_ALPHA or 1) local stakeTex, stakeText = getglobal(base .. "Stake"), getglobal(base .. "StakeText") if stake then stakeTex:Show() stakeText:SetText(tostring(stake)) else stakeTex:Hide() stakeText:SetText("") end getglobal(base .. "Highlight"):Hide() getglobal(base .. "Target"):Hide() end
-- How many times the Journal says `item` was picked, 0 when it does not list it. function BenillaHerb_Picks(item) for z = 1, GetHerbJournalZones() do local _, plants = GetHerbJournalZone(z) for j = 1, plants or 0 do local plant, picks = GetHerbJournalPlant(z, j) if plant == item then return picks end end end return 0 end
-- Lay `chips` out from `top`, wrapping to a new row when one would pass the column. function BenillaHerb_PlaceChips(chips, top) local width = BENILLA_HERB_WIDTH - 2 * BENILLA_HERB_MARGIN local x, y = 0, top for _, chip in ipairs(chips) do local w = getglobal(chip:GetName() .. "Text"):GetStringWidth() + 12 if x > 0 and x + w > width then x = 0 y = y + 20 end chip:SetWidth(w) chip:ClearAllPoints() chip:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", BenillaHerbPatch, "TOPLEFT", BENILLA_HERB_MARGIN + x, -y) chip:Show() x = x + w + 6 end end
-- Chip `n` of `pool` (named `prefix` .. n), made on first use, showing `text`. function BenillaHerb_PoolChip(pool, prefix, n, text) if not pool[n] then pool[n] = BenillaHerb_Chip(prefix .. n) end local chip = pool[n] getglobal(chip:GetName() .. "Text"):SetText(text) chip:SetAlpha(1) return chip end
function BenillaHerb_PaintChips(tool, cost, consumable, ready, armed) local shown = {} local n = 0 local toolName = BenillaHerb_ItemInfo(tool) if toolName then local text = "Tool |cffffffff" .. toolName .. "|r" if BenillaHerbState.skill then text = text .. " · " .. BenillaHerbState.skill .. " costs " .. BenillaHerb_Plural(cost, "pull") end n = n + 1 table.insert(shown, BenillaHerb_PoolChip(BenillaHerbState.chips, "BenillaHerbChip", n, text)) end local consumableName = BenillaHerb_ItemInfo(consumable) if consumableName then local state = "used" if armed then state = "armed" elseif ready then state = "ready" end n = n + 1 table.insert(shown, BenillaHerb_PoolChip(BenillaHerbState.chips, "BenillaHerbChip", n, "Item |cffffffff" .. consumableName .. "|r · " .. state)) end for k = 1, GetNumHerbNotes() do n = n + 1 table.insert(shown, BenillaHerb_PoolChip(BenillaHerbState.chips, "BenillaHerbChip", n, GetHerbNote(k))) end for k = n + 1, table.getn(BenillaHerbState.chips) do BenillaHerbState.chips[k]:Hide() end BenillaHerb_PlaceChips(shown, 112)
local known = {} local _, _, glintAt = GetHerbRevealAt() for k = 1, GetHerbKnown() do local item, present, rows = GetHerbKnownItem(k) local what = "not in this patch" if present then what = rows and rows ~= "" and ("row " .. rows) or "somewhere here" if glintAt and glintAt > 0 and BenillaHerb_Picks(item) >= glintAt then what = what .. " · glints" end end local chip = BenillaHerb_PoolChip(BenillaHerbState.known, "BenillaHerbKnownChip", k, BenillaHerb_Coloured(item) .. " " .. what) table.insert(known, chip) end for k = GetHerbKnown() + 1, table.getn(BenillaHerbState.known) do BenillaHerbState.known[k]:Hide() end BenillaHerb_PlaceChips(known, 134) for k = 1, GetHerbKnown() do local _, present = GetHerbKnownItem(k) if not present then BenillaHerbState.known[k]:SetAlpha(0.5) end end end
-- The pull pips: lit for each pull left, dark for each spent, six to a row. function BenillaHerb_PaintPips(pulls) local start = BenillaHerbState.start local n = 1 while getglobal("BenillaHerbPip" .. n) or n <= start do local pip = getglobal("BenillaHerbPip" .. n) if not pip then pip = BenillaHerbPatch:CreateTexture("BenillaHerbPip" .. n, "ARTWORK") pip:SetWidth(12) pip:SetHeight(12) local col, row = math.mod(n - 1, BENILLA_HERB_PIP_ROW), math.floor((n - 1) / BENILLA_HERB_PIP_ROW) pip:SetPoint("TOPRIGHT", BenillaHerbPatch, "TOPRIGHT", -BENILLA_HERB_MARGIN - (BENILLA_HERB_PIP_ROW - 1 - col) * 14, -46 - row * 14) end if n <= pulls then pip:SetTexture(BENILLA_HERB_ART .. "pip_on") pip:Show() elseif n <= start then pip:SetTexture(BENILLA_HERB_ART .. "pip_off") pip:Show() else pip:Hide() end n = n + 1 end end
function BenillaHerb_PaintBasket() local rows = GetNumHerbBasket() for n = 1, BENILLA_HERB_BASKET_ROWS do local base = "BenillaHerbBasket" .. n local item, count, part = GetHerbBasket(n) if item then local name, quality = BenillaHerb_ItemInfo(item) local r, g, b = BenillaHerb_Colour(quality) local glyph = getglobal(base .. "Glyph") glyph:SetTexture(BENILLA_HERB_ART .. "glyph_" .. (part ~= "" and part or "leaf")) glyph:SetVertexColor(r, g, b) getglobal(base .. "Name"):SetText(name or "Unknown plant") getglobal(base .. "Name"):SetTextColor(r, g, b) getglobal(base .. "Count"):SetText(tostring(count)) getglobal(base):Show() else getglobal(base):Hide() end end if rows == 0 then BenillaHerbBasketEmpty:SetText("Nothing yet. Pull a tile to start.") else BenillaHerbBasketEmpty:SetText("") end end
function BenillaHerb_PaintLog() local log = BenillaHerbState.log for n = 1, BENILLA_HERB_LOG_ENTRIES do local base = "BenillaHerbLogEntry" .. n local e = log[n] if e then local colour = BENILLA_HERB_LOG_COLOURS[e.kind] or BENILLA_HERB_LOG_COLOURS[0] getglobal(base .. "Bar"):SetTexture(colour[1], colour[2], colour[3], 1) getglobal(base .. "Title"):SetText(e.title) getglobal(base .. "Place"):SetText(e.place or "") getglobal(base .. "Xp"):SetText(e.xp and e.xp > 0 and ("+" .. e.xp .. " XP") or "") getglobal(base):Show() else getglobal(base):Hide() end end end
function BenillaHerb_PaintLevel() local _, level, xp, toNext = GetHerbalistInfo() BenillaHerbLevel:SetText("Herbalism " .. (level or 0)) BenillaHerbXPBar:SetMinMaxValues(0, math.max(toNext or 0, 1)) BenillaHerbXPBar:SetValue(xp or 0) BenillaHerbXPText:SetText((xp or 0) .. " / " .. (toNext or 0)) end
function BenillaHerb_Paint() local open, size, pulls, tool, cost, consumable, ready, armed, block, grown, factor, thorns, xp, over = GetHerbGrid() if not open then return end BenillaHerbState.missing = false
-- The header. BenillaHerbMeta:SetText((block or "") .. " · " .. size .. "×" .. size .. " · grown for herbalism " .. (grown or 0)) local bloom = {} for n = 1, GetNumHerbBloom() do table.insert(bloom, BenillaHerb_Coloured(GetHerbBloom(n))) end if table.getn(bloom) > 0 then local times = string.gsub(string.format("%.1f", factor or 1), "%.0$", "") BenillaHerbBloomLine:SetText("In bloom (×" .. times .. "): " .. table.concat(bloom, ", ")) BenillaHerbBloomLine:Show() else BenillaHerbBloomLine:Hide() end BenillaHerbPulls:SetText(tostring(pulls)) BenillaHerb_PaintPips(pulls) local gathered = 0 for n = 1, GetNumHerbBasket() do local _, count = GetHerbBasket(n) gathered = gathered + (count or 0) end BenillaHerbTally:SetText("Basket " .. gathered .. " · Thorns " .. (thorns or 0) .. " · +" .. (xp or 0) .. " XP") BenillaHerb_PaintLevel()
for i = 1, BENILLA_HERB_SIZE * BENILLA_HERB_SIZE do BenillaHerbTile_Paint(i) end
-- The skill button, named for the tool's skill with its cost. local toolName = BenillaHerb_ItemInfo(tool) BenillaHerbState.skill = toolName and BENILLA_HERB_SKILLS[toolName] BenillaHerb_PaintChips(tool, cost, consumable, ready, armed) if BenillaHerbState.skill and not over then BenillaHerbSkill:SetText(BenillaHerbState.skill .. " · " .. BenillaHerb_Plural(cost, "pull")) BenillaHerbSkill:Show() else BenillaHerbSkill:Hide() if BenillaHerbState.mode == "skill" then BenillaHerbState.mode = nil end end if BenillaHerbState.skill == "Sweep" and BenillaHerbState.mode == "skill" then BenillaHerbAcross:SetText(BenillaHerbState.across and "Across" or "Down") BenillaHerbAcross:Show() else BenillaHerbAcross:Hide() end -- The consumable button. local consumableName = BenillaHerb_ItemInfo(consumable) local kind = consumableName and BENILLA_HERB_CONSUMABLES[consumableName] BenillaHerbState.kind = kind if ready and kind and not over then local text = "Use " .. consumableName if kind == "sight" and BenillaHerbState.mode == "sight" then text = text .. " (" .. table.getn(BenillaHerbState.sight) .. "/" .. BENILLA_HERB_SIGHT_PICKS .. ")" end BenillaHerbConsumable:SetText(text) BenillaHerbConsumable:Show() if (kind == "charm" and armed) or BenillaHerbState.mode == kind then BenillaHerbConsumable:LockHighlight() else BenillaHerbConsumable:UnlockHighlight() end else BenillaHerbConsumable:Hide() if BenillaHerbState.mode == "sight" or BenillaHerbState.mode == "twine" then BenillaHerbState.mode = nil end end
-- The end card takes the legend's place and Close takes the buttons'. if over then BenillaHerbState.mode = nil BenillaHerbEndReason:SetText(BENILLA_HERB_OVER[over] or BENILLA_HERB_CLOSED[over] or "") BenillaHerbEndSummary:SetText("You gathered " .. BenillaHerb_Plural(gathered, "plant") .. " · +" .. (xp or 0) .. " XP") BenillaHerbEnd:Show() BenillaHerbLegend:Hide() BenillaHerbLeave:Hide() BenillaHerbClose:Show() else BenillaHerbEnd:Hide() BenillaHerbLegend:Show() BenillaHerbLeave:Show() BenillaHerbClose:Hide() end BenillaHerb_PaintBasket() BenillaHerb_PaintLog() end
function BenillaHerb_OnUpdate() if not GetHerbGrid() then -- An ended patch keeps its window, and its end card, until Close. if BenillaHerbPatch:IsVisible() and not BenillaHerbState.over then BenillaHerbPatch:Hide() end return end -- A known plant's glow pulses between 0.35 and 1. local clock = BenillaHerbState.clock + arg1 BenillaHerbState.clock = math.mod(clock, BENILLA_HERB_GLOW_PERIOD) local alpha = 0.675 - 0.325 * math.cos(2 * math.pi * BenillaHerbState.clock / BENILLA_HERB_GLOW_PERIOD) for i = 1, BENILLA_HERB_SIZE * BENILLA_HERB_SIZE do getglobal("BenillaHerbTile" .. i .. "Glow"):SetAlpha(alpha) end if BenillaHerbState.missing then BenillaHerbState.wait = (BenillaHerbState.wait or 0) + arg1 if BenillaHerbState.wait > 0.5 then BenillaHerbState.wait = 0 BenillaHerb_Paint() end end end
function BenillaHerb_Update() local open, _, pulls, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, over = GetHerbGrid() if not open then return end -- A new patch: the window was closed, or still shows the end card of the last one. if not BenillaHerbPatch:IsVisible() or (BenillaHerbState.over and not over) then BenillaHerbState.mode = nil BenillaHerbState.sight = {} BenillaHerbState.log = {} BenillaHerbState.start = pulls BenillaHerbPatch:Show() end if pulls > BenillaHerbState.start then BenillaHerbState.start = pulls end BenillaHerbState.over = over local kind, title, place, xp = GetHerbLog() if title and title ~= "" then table.insert(BenillaHerbState.log, 1, { kind = kind, title = title, place = place, xp = xp }) while table.getn(BenillaHerbState.log) > BENILLA_HERB_LOG_ENTRIES do table.remove(BenillaHerbState.log) end end BenillaHerb_Paint() end
function BenillaHerb_Closed(reason) BenillaHerbState.mode = nil BenillaHerbState.sight = {} -- The patch ran out of pulls or tiles: its end card already says so. if BenillaHerbState.over and BenillaHerbPatch:IsVisible() and BENILLA_HERB_OVER[reason] then return end BenillaHerbState.over = nil BenillaHerbPatch:Hide() local text = BENILLA_HERB_CLOSED[reason] if text and DEFAULT_CHAT_FRAME then DEFAULT_CHAT_FRAME:AddMessage(text, 1, 1, 0) end end
function BenillaHerbClose_OnClick() BenillaHerbState.over = nil BenillaHerbPatch:Hide() end
function BenillaHerbTile_OnClick() if BenillaHerbState.over then return end local i = this:GetID() local state = GetHerbTile(i) local mode = BenillaHerbState.mode if mode == "skill" then local skill = BenillaHerbState.skill if skill == "Sweep" then HerbSweep(i, BenillaHerbState.across) elseif skill == "Probe" then HerbProbe(i) elseif skill == "Snip" then HerbSnip(i) end BenillaHerbState.mode = nil elseif mode == "twine" then HerbTwine(i) BenillaHerbState.mode = nil elseif mode == "sight" then if state == 0 then local picks = BenillaHerbState.sight local dup = false for _, p in ipairs(picks) do if p == i then dup = true end end if not dup then table.insert(picks, i) end if table.getn(picks) >= BENILLA_HERB_SIGHT_PICKS then HerbSight(picks[1], picks[2], picks[3]) BenillaHerbState.sight = {} BenillaHerbState.mode = nil end end elseif state == 0 then HerbPull(i) end BenillaHerb_Paint() end
function BenillaHerbTile_OnEnter() local i = this:GetID() local _, _, stake = GetHerbTile(i) local counted = stake and BenillaHerb_Around(i) or {} local covered = BenillaHerbState.mode and BenillaHerb_Covered(i) or {} for n = 1, BENILLA_HERB_SIZE * BENILLA_HERB_SIZE do local base = "BenillaHerbTile" .. n if counted[n] then getglobal(base .. "Highlight"):Show() else getglobal(base .. "Highlight"):Hide() end if covered[n] then getglobal(base .. "Target"):Show() else getglobal(base .. "Target"):Hide() end end end
function BenillaHerbTile_OnLeave() for n = 1, BENILLA_HERB_SIZE * BENILLA_HERB_SIZE do getglobal("BenillaHerbTile" .. n .. "Highlight"):Hide() getglobal("BenillaHerbTile" .. n .. "Target"):Hide() end end
function BenillaHerbSkill_OnClick() if BenillaHerbState.mode == "skill" then BenillaHerbState.mode = nil else BenillaHerbState.mode = "skill" BenillaHerbState.sight = {} end BenillaHerb_Paint() end
function BenillaHerbAcross_OnClick() BenillaHerbState.across = not BenillaHerbState.across BenillaHerb_Paint() end
function BenillaHerbConsumable_OnClick() local kind = BenillaHerbState.kind if kind == "charm" then HerbArmCharm() elseif BenillaHerbState.mode == kind then BenillaHerbState.mode = nil BenillaHerbState.sight = {} else BenillaHerbState.mode = kind BenillaHerbState.sight = {} end BenillaHerb_Paint() end

Scripts.OnLoad: BenillaHerbTitle:SetText("Herb patch") BenillaHerbPullsLabel:SetText("PULLS LEFT") BenillaHerbBasketTitle:SetText("Basket") BenillaHerbLogTitle:SetText("Pull log") BenillaHerbLeave:SetText("Leave patch") BenillaHerbClose:SetText("Close") BenillaHerb_Build() this:RegisterEvent("HERB_GRID_UPDATE") this:RegisterEvent("HERB_GRID_CLOSED") this:RegisterEvent("HERBALIST_UPDATE")
Scripts.OnEvent: if event == "HERB_GRID_UPDATE" then BenillaHerb_Update() elseif event == "HERB_GRID_CLOSED" then BenillaHerb_Closed(arg1) elseif event == "HERBALIST_UPDATE" and BenillaHerbPatch:IsVisible() then BenillaHerb_PaintLevel() end
